item.title: GlideRail 2.1.0
item.description:
• GhostCue is now GlideRail. Same app, same license, new name and icon. Your notes and settings carry over.
  • New first-run tour: watch your note vanish from a live preview of your own screen.
  • Monthly plan ($19.99/mo) alongside Annual and Lifetime. Change or cancel any time from Settings.
  • Live Rail and Voice Follow on Apple Silicon: clearer microphone states, with an Open System Settings shortcut when access is denied.
  • Cue cards: real previous/next controls, your own note as the demo deck, and slice mode explains itself.
  • New Help menu: replay the tour, contact support.
  • Fixes: note titles no longer keep the #, trial days count down correctly, and plan status stays accurate in the background.
